title: Reva: Real-Time Vulnerability Detection through Contextual Probing of Large Language Models
title_zh: Reva：通过大语言模型上下文探测实现实时漏洞检测

paragraphs.en: A vulnerability costs more to fix the later it is discovered in the software lifecycle. As coding agents now generate code faster than developers can review it, software needs a stronger first line of defense that screens each new function in real time, as it is generated. LLM agents have recently become capable of finding real-world vulnerabilities by working as a security expert would: they run analysis tools, explore the surrounding code, test hypotheses and weigh the evidence before forming their own judgement. This reasoning, however, spans many model calls, so that each verdict takes minutes of compute, far too long to keep pace with code generation. Faster AI-based detectors, which fine-tune deep learning models or prompt an LLM for a direct verdict, are considerably less accurate: they judge a function without the context an agent gathers, and an LLM’s generated verdict has proven unreliable in prior work even when some of that context is given.

paragraphs.en: We present Reva (REal-time Vulnerability Analysis), an AI vulnerability detector that brings the security context and code understanding components behind agentic detectors into a single forward pass of an LLM. For each new function, Reva provides the LLM with a pre-computed threat model of its module, along with lightweight static analysis findings and call-graph information. Rather than asking the LLM for a verdict, Reva lets a trained probe read the LLM’s internal representations of the function in this context. On PrimeVul’s held-out test set, Reva on GLM-5.3-Flash reaches 60.0% accuracy in about one second per function. This matches VulTriage (59.2%), the state-of-the-art agentic function-level detector in the literature, run on the same LLM, while being over 250 times faster and less than a tenth as costly. On the same prompt, the probe is 14% to 17% more accurate than the LLM’s own direct verdict. Across three open LLMs, Reva is at least as accurate as VulTriage, and about 10% more accurate on two of them. These results suggest that an LLM’s internal representations already encode much of what agentic detectors obtain through reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Reva（REal-time Vulnerability Analysis，实时漏洞分析），一个 AI 漏洞检测器，它将智能体检测器背后的安全上下文与代码理解组件整合到大语言模型（LLM）的单次前向传播中。 对于每个新函数，Reva 向 LLM 提供其所属模块的预先计算的威胁模型，以及轻量级静态分析结果和调用图信息。 Reva 不要求 LLM 给出判断结论，而是让一个经过训练的探针在该上下文中读取 LLM 对该函数的内部表示。 在 PrimeVul 的留出测试集上，基于 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 Reva 达到 60.0% 的准确率，每个函数耗时约一秒。 这与 VulTriage（59.2%）——文献中最先进的智能体函数级检测器——在同一 LLM 上的表现相当，同时速度超过其 250 倍，成本不足其十分之一。 在相同的提示下，该探针的准确率比 LLM 自身的直接判断高出 14% 至 17%。 在三个开源 LLM 上，Reva 的准确率至少与 VulTriage 相当，并在其中两个上高出约 10%。 这些结果表明，LLM 的内部表示已经编码了智能体检测器通过推理所获得的许多信息。

paragraphs.en: Static analyzers run in real time, but at the scale of agent-generated code, they produce more reports than developers can review, many of them false positives [ 2 , 3 ] . LLM agents have recently become capable of finding real-world vulnerabilities [ 4 , 5 ] by combining such tools with their own analysis of the code, and agentic detectors bring this approach to function-level detection. VulTriage [ 6 ] , the state of the art in the function-level detection literature, and VulAgent [ 7 ] enrich the prompt with retrieved vulnerability knowledge and program facts, and VulTrial [ 8 ] lets several agents debate a verdict. This reasoning, however, spans several model calls, which amounts to minutes per function. Faster AI-based detectors, which fine-tune deep learning models or prompt an LLM for a direct verdict, reduce this latency but are considerably less accurate [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 静态分析器可以实时运行，但在智能体生成代码的规模下，它们产生的报告数量超出了开发者所能审查的范围，其中许多是误报 [ 2 , 3 ] 。 大语言模型智能体最近已能够通过将此类工具与自身对代码的分析相结合来发现现实世界中的漏洞 [ 4 , 5 ] ，而智能体式检测器将这一方法应用于函数级检测。 VulTriage [ 6 ] 是函数级检测文献中的最先进方法，它与 VulAgent [ 7 ] 都通过检索到的漏洞知识和程序事实来丰富提示词，VulTrial [ 8 ] 则让多个智能体就判定结果进行辩论。 然而这种推理过程涉及多次模型调用，相当于每个函数需要数分钟。 更快的基于 AI 的检测器通过微调深度学习模型或提示大语言模型直接给出判定来降低延迟，但准确率明显较低 [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] 。

sents.en: Faster AI-based detectors, which fine-tune deep learning models or prompt an LLM for a direct verdict, reduce this latency but are considerably less accurate [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] .

paragraphs.en: Reva is designed to close this gap between speed and improved accuracy. Instead of letting the LLM gather context through multiple rounds of tool calls, Reva assembles it in the prompt, including a threat model of the function’s module, its static analysis findings, its call graph and its file. Instead of reasoning towards a verdict, the LLM then processes this prompt in a single forward pass without generating text, and a small probe trained on labeled functions maps its internal representations of the code tokens to a risk score. This second choice builds on evidence that LLMs encode knowledge that their answers do not express, for example about the truth of a statement [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] or the correctness of their own answers [ 15 , 16 ] , and that chain-of-thought explanations are not always faithful to the underlying computation [ 17 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Reva 的设计目的是弥合速度与更高准确率之间的这一差距。 Reva 不是让大语言模型通过多轮工具调用收集上下文，而是直接在提示词中组装好上下文，包括该函数所在模块的威胁模型、其静态分析结果、其调用图以及其所在文件。 大语言模型随后不再通过推理得出结论，而是以单次前向传播处理该提示词且不生成文本，一个在带标签函数上训练的小型探针将其对代码词元的内部表示映射为一个风险评分。 第二种选择基于如下证据：大语言模型编码了其回答中并未表达的知识，例如关于某陈述是否为真的知识 [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] 或关于其自身回答是否正确的知识 [ 15 , 16 ] ，并且思维链解释并不总是忠实于底层计算 [ 17 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Reva on PrimeVul [ 9 ] , a high-quality dataset of vulnerable C and C++ functions paired with benign versions of the same functions, which spans 651 projects and 121 vulnerability types (CWEs). On its held-out test set, Reva on GLM-5.3-Flash [ 18 ] is on par with VulTriage and more accurate than VulAgent run on the same LLM, in about one second per function, over 250 times faster than VulTriage. On two other open LLMs, it is 9% to 13% more accurate than both agentic detectors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 PrimeVul [ 9 ] 上评估 Reva，这是一个高质量的漏洞 C 与 C++ 函数数据集，其中每个漏洞函数都配有同一函数的良性版本，涵盖 651 个项目和 121 种漏洞类型（CWE）。 在其留出测试集上，基于 GLM-5.3-Flash [ 18 ] 的 Reva 与 VulTriage 相当，且比在相同大语言模型上运行的 VulAgent 更准确，每个函数耗时约一秒，比 VulTriage 快 250 倍以上。 在另外两个开源大语言模型上，它比这两个智能体检测器准确率高 9% 到 13%。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes three contributions: (i) we propose Reva , a vulnerability detector that combines targeted security context with a probe on an LLM’s internal representations, in a single forward pass per function; (ii) we compare it with state-of-the-art agentic function-level detectors run on the same three LLMs, on PrimeVul’s held-out test set, in terms of accuracy, cost and robustness; and (iii) we outline a research agenda towards detectors that screen every function as coding agents generate it and escalate likely vulnerabilities to more capable agents that construct a proof of vulnerability.
paragraphs.zh: 本文有三点贡献：(i) 我们提出 Reva，一个漏洞检测器，它将针对性的安全上下文与对 LLM 内部表示的探测相结合，每个函数只需一次前向传播；(ii) 我们在 PrimeVul 的保留测试集上，从准确率、成本和鲁棒性方面，将其与运行在相同三个 LLM 上的最先进的智能体式函数级检测器进行比较；(iii) 我们概述了一个研究议程，旨在实现能够在编码智能体生成每个函数时对其进行筛查，并将疑似漏洞升级给更强大的智能体以构建漏洞证明的检测器。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based vulnerability detection. LLMs in non-agentic settings typically struggle to tell a vulnerable function from its benign counterpart: on PrimeVul [ 9 ] , GPT-4 with chain-of-thought labels both versions correctly in only 12.9% of the pairs, and LLMs asked for a verdict in non-agentic settings, often reason inconsistently about security [ 19 , 20 ] . Reva instead reads the LLM’s internal representations rather than its answer or reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的漏洞检测。 在非智能体设置下，LLM 通常难以区分易受攻击的函数与其良性对应版本：在 PrimeVul [9] 上，使用思维链的 GPT-4 仅在 12.9% 的配对中同时正确标注两个版本；而在非智能体设置下被要求给出判断的 LLM，对安全问题的推理常常不一致 [19, 20]。 Reva 则读取 LLM 的内部表示，而非其回答或推理。

sents.zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的漏洞检测。

paragraphs.en: Agentic detectors. Recent detectors improve accuracy by adding knowledge and reasoning steps. VulTriage retrieves CWE descriptions and verbalizes control- and data-flow facts [ 6 ] , VulAgent lets specialized agents propose and validate hypotheses against the project’s code [ 7 ] , and VulTrial stages a debate between agents [ 8 ] . Their cost grows with each call, and their context can exceed the LLM’s context window. Reva instead pre-loads the key parts of this context into the prompt and replaces the multi-step reasoning with a single probed forward pass.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式检测器。 近期的检测器通过增加知识和推理步骤来提升准确率。 VulTriage 检索 CWE 描述并将控制流和数据流事实转化为文字 [ 6 ]，VulAgent 让专门的智能体针对项目代码提出并验证假设 [ 7]，VulTrial 则安排智能体之间进行辩论 [ 8 ]。 它们的开销随每次调用而增长，且其上下文可能超出大语言模型的上下文窗口。 Reva 则是将该上下文的关键部分预加载到提示词中，并用单次探测式前向传播取代多步推理。

sents.en: Agentic detectors.
sents.zh: 智能体式检测器。

sents.en: Recent detectors improve accuracy by adding knowledge and reasoning steps.
sents.zh: 近期的检测器通过增加知识和推理步骤来提升准确率。

sents.en: VulTriage retrieves CWE descriptions and verbalizes control- and data-flow facts [ 6 ] , VulAgent lets specialized agents propose and validate hypotheses against the project’s code [ 7 ] , and VulTrial stages a debate between agents [ 8 ] .
sents.zh: VulTriage 检索 CWE 描述并将控制流和数据流事实转化为文字 [ 6 ]，VulAgent 让专门的智能体针对项目代码提出并验证假设 [ 7]，VulTrial 则安排智能体之间进行辩论 [ 8 ]。

sents.en: Their cost grows with each call, and their context can exceed the LLM’s context window.
sents.zh: 它们的开销随每次调用而增长，且其上下文可能超出大语言模型的上下文窗口。

sents.en: Reva instead pre-loads the key parts of this context into the prompt and replaces the multi-step reasoning with a single probed forward pass.
sents.zh: Reva 则是将该上下文的关键部分预加载到提示词中，并用单次探测式前向传播取代多步推理。

paragraphs.en: Probing LLM internal representations. Probes are small classifiers trained on a model’s hidden states [ 21 ] . For code, linear probes indicates some capability to separate secure from insecure code on toy datasets [ 22 , 23 ] , and predict whether generated code will be insecure or incorrect [ 24 , 25 ] . These probes read the code alone, whereas Reva probes real-world functions read with targeted security context.
paragraphs.zh: 探测大语言模型的内部表示。 探针是在模型隐藏状态上训练的小型分类器 [ 21 ] 。 对于代码而言，线性探针表明在玩具数据集上具备一定的区分安全与不安全代码的能力 [ 22 , 23 ] ，并能预测生成的代码是否不安全或不正确 [ 24 , 25 ] 。 这些探针仅读取代码本身，而 Reva 则在带有多目标安全上下文的情况下探测真实世界的函数读取过程。

paragraphs.en: Pitfalls of vulnerability benchmarks. Detectors can exploit spurious features of their datasets, such as code metrics or semantics unrelated to the vulnerability [ 26 , 27 ] . Such a detector tends to classify a vulnerable function and its benign counterpart with the same label, which share these features. We therefore score each function independently, then check whether the two versions of each pair receive their correct labels.
paragraphs.zh: 漏洞基准的陷阱。 检测器可能利用其数据集中的虚假特征，例如与漏洞无关的代码度量或语义 [ 26 , 27 ] 。 这样的检测器往往会将易受攻击的函数与其良性对应版本分类为同一标签，因为二者共享这些特征。 因此，我们对每个函数独立评分，然后检查每一对函数的两个版本是否获得各自正确的标签。

paragraphs.en: In Reva , an LLM reads a new function with its security context in one forward pass, and a probe maps the hidden states of the code tokens to a risk score (Fig. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 Reva 中，大语言模型（LLM）在一次前向传递中读取新函数及其安全上下文，然后由一个探针将代码标记的隐藏状态映射为风险评分（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: ①Prompt with security context. The prompt contains the new function and the context around it, in labeled sections (Fig. 1 ). A threat model, built once per project by a workflow of LLM agents over the entire software, describes the project (summary, attacker-controlled inputs, trust boundaries) and the module that contains the function (role, inputs that reach it, typical sinks and guards). The prompt adds the Semgrep [ 28 ] findings for the function, its call sites and the signatures of the helpers it calls, and the includes, types, macros and sibling functions of its file, extracted with tree-sitter from the repository. It is available for 84% of the training functions; otherwise the prompt has the function and its Semgrep findings only. The median prompt has 3,840 tokens, 601 of them code.
paragraphs.zh: ①带安全上下文的提示词。 该提示词包含新函数及其周边上下文，分为带标签的多个部分（图 1）。 威胁模型由一组大语言模型智能体（LLM agents）针对整个软件构建，每个项目仅构建一次，它描述该项目（摘要、攻击者可控的输入、信任边界）以及包含该函数的模块（角色、到达该函数的输入、典型的汇点与防护措施）。 提示词中还加入了该函数的 Semgrep [28] 检查结果、其调用点以及它所调用的辅助函数的签名，还有其所在文件的头文件包含、类型、宏和同文件中的其他函数，这些内容用 tree-sitter 从代码仓库中提取。 该模型覆盖 84% 的训练函数；对于其余函数，提示词仅包含该函数本身及其 Semgrep 检查结果。 提示词的中位长度为 3,840 个词元，其中 601 个为代码。

paragraphs.en: ②One forward pass. The LLM processes the prompt in one forward pass that stops after the deepest of four probed layers, so the remaining layers are never run and it generates no output token. We probe intermediate layers, which probing studies often find most informative [ 21 ] : four evenly spaced layers from 38% to 85% of the depth of the LLM, selected by cross-validation.
paragraphs.zh: ②一次前向传播。 该大语言模型在一次前向传播中处理提示，该前向传播在四个被探测层中最深的一层之后停止，因此其余各层从不运行，也不会生成任何输出词元。 我们探测中间层，探测研究通常发现这些层信息量最大 [ 21 ] ：即从大语言模型深度 38% 到 85% 之间等距选取的四层，通过交叉验证选出。

paragraphs.en: ④Attention probe. A probe with 8 attention heads pools the token states into one risk score. It has 0.57 M parameters and is trained on PrimeVul’s training functions. Its loss combines a per-function classification term with a term that ranks each vulnerable function above its benign counterpart. These pairs serve only in training: Reva scores each function on its own.
paragraphs.zh: ④注意力探针。 一个具有8个注意力头的探针将词元状态汇聚为一个风险分数。 它有0.57 M个参数，并在PrimeVUL的训练函数上训练。 它的损失函数将逐函数分类项与一个排序项相结合，该排序项使每个易受攻击函数的排名高于其对应的良性版本。 这些配对仅用于训练：Reva对每个函数独立打分。

paragraphs.en: Use in practice. The LLM and Semgrep’s rules are loaded once at startup, so they don’t have to be booted for each new analysis, and each project’s threat model is built ahead of time. For each new function, Reva extracts its context, runs Semgrep, builds the prompt, runs the pass and applies the probe. With Muse-Glimmer-30B on one H200 GPU, this takes 0.93 s per function, 0.46 s of which is context extraction.
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中应用。 大语言模型与 Semgrep 的规则在启动时加载一次，因此无需为每次新分析重新启动，且每个项目的威胁模型均提前构建好。 对于每个新函数，Reva 会提取其上下文、运行 Semgrep、构建提示词、执行该遍处理并应用探针。 在单块 H200 GPU 上运行 Muse-Glimmer-30B 时，每个函数耗时 0.93 秒，其中 0.46 秒用于上下文提取。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Reva through three research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过三个研究问题来评估 Reva：

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How accurate is Reva compared with agentic detectors running on the same LLM?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1：与运行在同一 LLM 上的智能体检测器相比，Reva 的准确性如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: How much computation does Reva save?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：Reva 节省了多少计算量？

paragraphs.en: RQ3: Which parts of Reva matter, and is its accuracy robust to leakage and selection?
paragraphs.zh: RQ3：Reva 的哪些部分起作用，其准确性对泄露和选择是否具有鲁棒性？

paragraphs.en: Dataset and metrics. PrimeVul [ 9 ] pairs each vulnerable C/C++ function with a benign version of the same function. It has 3,789 training, 480 validation and 435 test pairs. Following [ 9 ] , we count the pairs in which both versions are labeled correctly ( P-C ), both are flagged ( P-V ), both are cleared ( P-B ), or the labels are reversed ( P-R ). Our main metric is accuracy over all functions, each scored independently.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集与评估指标。 PrimeVul [9] 将每个存在漏洞的 C/C++ 函数与同一函数的良性版本配对。 它包含 3,789 对训练数据、480 对验证数据和 435 对测试数据。 遵循 [9]，我们统计两个版本均被正确标注（P-C）、均被标记为漏洞（P-V）、均被判定为无漏洞（P-B）、或标签相反（P-R）的配对数量。 我们的主要指标是所有函数上的准确率，每个函数独立计分。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. We made every design choice on the training and validation sets only. Cross-validation (CV) accuracy covers five folds of the training set, with all functions of a commit in the same fold, and the validation set, scored by a probe trained on the full training set. The test set stayed unseen during development and was scored only with the final configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 实验方案。 我们的所有设计选择仅基于训练集和验证集做出。 交叉验证（CV）准确率覆盖训练集的五个折，同一提交（commit）中的所有函数都位于同一折中；验证集则由在整个训练集上训练的探针模型进行评分。 测试集在开发过程中从未被接触，仅在最终配置确定后进行评分。

paragraphs.en: LLMs. We use three open-weight LLMs: Muse-Glimmer-30B [ 29 ] , Qwen3.8-27B [ 30 ] and GLM-5.3-Flash [ 18 ] , a larger mixture-of-experts model. On GLM-5.3-Flash, the agentic detectors use the FP8 version of the LLM and Reva an exact BF16 conversion, which leaves its cross-validation accuracy unchanged (66.2% vs. 65.9%).
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型。 我们使用三个开放权重大语言模型：Muse-Glimmer-30B [ 29 ]、Qwen3.8-27B [ 30 ] 以及 GLM-5.3-Flash [ 18 ]，后者是一个更大的混合专家模型。 在 GLM-5.3-Flash 上，智能体检测器使用该大语言模型的 FP8 版本，而 Reva 使用精确的 BF16 转换，这使其交叉验证准确率保持不变（66.2% 对 65.9%）。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We run VulAgent and VulTriage on their released code, using the same LLMs as Reva . A function is failed when the detector returns no verdict, usually because the reasoning exceeds the token limit. We compare all methods over all functions, counting failed functions as benign. Published GPT-4o results are given for context.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 我们在它们发布的代码上运行 VulAgent 和 VulTriage，使用与 Reva 相同的大语言模型。 当检测器未返回判定结果时，该函数即视为失败，通常是因为推理超出了令牌限制。 我们在所有函数上比较所有方法，将失败的函数计为良性。 已发表的 GPT-4o 结果仅作参考。

paragraphs.en: On GLM-5.3-Flash, Reva reaches 60.0% accuracy (95% CI [57.8, 62.2]), against 59.2% for VulTriage and 52.8% for VulAgent run on the same LLM (Table I ). Over all test functions, Reva is 0.8 points above VulTriage (CI [ − - 2.1, +3.8]) and 7.2 points above VulAgent (CI [+4.4, +10.3]). On Qwen3.8-27B and Muse-Glimmer-30B, Reva is 5.1 to 6.7 points more accurate than both agentic detectors, and all four confidence intervals exclude zero.

paragraphs.en: We ablate each component of Reva on the Muse-Glimmer-30B validation set (Fig. 3 ). Asking the same LLM for a Yes/No verdict on the same prompt, instead of probing it, reduces accuracy to chance. On the test set, it stays 7.4 to 8.7 points below the probe, and Semgrep, Cppcheck and Flawfinder alone are also at chance (50.8% to 51.3%). The LLM’s internal representations thus carry information that neither its verdict nor the static-analysis findings provide alone. Within the probe, replacing attention pooling by a plain average of the token states lowers accuracy by 4.2 points, which suggests that the evidence of a vulnerability lies in a few tokens. Using a single layer, omitting the standardization or dropping the ranking term lowers accuracy by 0.4 to 1.5 points, and removing the repository context or keeping only the function by 1.0 and 1.9 points, none of which is significant. On PrimeVul’s short functions, the function alone thus carries most of the signal; we expect the context to matter more for interprocedural vulnerabilities.

paragraphs.en: Leakage and selection on the evaluation data can inflate probing results [ 21 , 31 ] . When no project appears in both training and evaluation folds, cross-validation accuracy drops by only 1.3 to 2.7 points, so most of what the probe learns transfers to unseen projects. Likewise, choosing the four probed layers on the training folds only, instead of on all development data, changes accuracy by less than half a point, so the layer choice does not inflate the results. Accuracy is, however, 6 points lower on the test set than in cross-validation (60.0% against 66.2% for GLM-5.3-Flash). As PrimeVul splits its data chronologically, this gap likely reflects the shift towards newer code, which cross-validation does not capture.
paragraphs.zh: 评估数据上的泄漏和选择可能会夸大探测结果 [21, 31]。 当训练折和评估折中没有共同出现的项目时，交叉验证准确率仅下降 1.3 至 2.7 个百分点，因此探测器学到的大部分内容可以迁移到未见过的项目。 同样，仅在训练折上（而不是在全部开发数据上）选择四个被探测的层，准确率变化不足半个百分点，因此层的选择不会夸大结果。 然而，测试集上的准确率比交叉验证低 6 个百分点（GLM-5.3-Flash 为 60.0% 对 66.2%）。 由于 PrimeVul 按时间顺序划分数据，这一差距可能反映了对更新代码的分布变化，而交叉验证未能捕捉到这一点。

paragraphs.en: Reva detects vulnerabilities by probing an LLM’s internal representations of a function and its security context in a single forward pass. On PrimeVul’s held-out test set, it matches or exceeds agentic detectors run on the same LLM, with fewer false positives, in about one second per function and at a small fraction of their cost. An LLM’s internal representations thus carry more information about vulnerabilities than its verdicts, and reading them enables real-time screening of every function as it is written.
